comments.body:
Follow-up commit: the Anthropic streaming path in `capture_streaming_event` only copied the cache fields, so `$ai_reasoning_tokens` never reached `$ai_generation` for streams. It now sets the field when > 0, with sync and async tests asserting the event properties.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
